scientific_integrity: The only originality target is the random-centered two-scale Gaussian limit and independent-Gaussian observable pivot, not the finite joint distribution or the first-order exponential singleton limit. Analytical proof and exact finite-state checks are distinguished.
scientific_limitations: Equal-weight independent single-coupon draws; no rate of convergence; first-order limit and finite joint law are prior work; historical equivalence of the second-order random-centered Gaussian theorem remains a residual risk.
title: A random-centered Gaussian law for singleton coupons at collection completion
